scope: Two independently started games. Each atomic public API component creates two extra balls at one kicker and then kicks/destroys in opposite orders, retaining immediate script snapshots. No Hit handler, body state, clock, RNG, timer deadline or expected outcome is supplied. CStr observations retain native script precision; these are component inputs, not naturally enrolled multiball or proof of the reported intermittent hold.

Dim CreationFirst,CreationSecond,CreationBefore,CreationAfter,CreationRemoved,CreationFinal
Function CreationPose(ball)
 CreationPose=CStr(ball.ID)&","&CStr(ball.X)&","&CStr(ball.Y)&","&CStr(ball.Z)&","&CStr(ball.VelX)&","&CStr(ball.VelY)&","&CStr(ball.VelZ)
End Function
Function CreationState()
 Dim all,ball,ids
 ids="":all=GetBalls()
 For Each ball In all:ids=ids&CStr(ball.ID)&",":Next
 CreationState=CreationPose(CreationFirst)&";"&CreationPose(CreationSecond)&";"&ids
End Function
Set CreationFirst=HellHouse.CreateBall
Set CreationSecond=HellHouse.CreateBall
CreationBefore=CreationState()
HellHouse.Kick 164,12,0
CreationAfter=CreationState()
CreationRemoved=HellHouse.DestroyBall
CreationFinal=CreationState()
